name: prophet-kevin-online
description: Prophet Kevin Online — Android/iOS member app (Capacitor), creator dashboard, on Supabase.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/channel.test.ts tests/backend.test.ts tests/stream.test.ts tests/e2e/app.e2e.ts tests/e2e/admin.e2e.ts tests/e2e/demo.e2e.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/e2e/app.e2e.ts tests/e2e/admin.e2e.ts
scripts.android:apk: npm run native:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.native:android: npm run native:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.native:ios: npm run native:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:demo: npm run build && DEMO=1 node scripts/write-config.mjs && node scripts/build-demo.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
